description:
False block, worse under deny. tests_policy.touches_tests (lines 65-71) blocks when a test exists before or after the edit. An Edit of `{ a + b }` in src/lib.rs that also holds #[cfg(test)] mod tests gets test_write_gate. The same holds for a Python module with test functions.

Fix: for a non-test path, compare the extracted test units (test_units.extract, plus the Rust cfg(test) block text) before and after, block only when they differ. A test path keeps the name rule.

Acceptance: editing non-test code in a Rust file with inline tests passes; editing the tests module blocks; deleting a test blocks. Tests by adw-test-writer.
title: Block a Rust edit only when its inline tests change
